description: This file contains styles for the Tic Tac Toe frontend application, defining various layout and appearance aspects such as colors, grid displays, and responsive design.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Styles for the main application container, including layout and alignment properties.

classes.name: game-board
classes.description: Styles for the game board layout, using a grid layout with defined column repetitions.

classes.name: cell
classes.description: Styles for individual cells within the game board, including layout and border properties.

classes.name: player-token
classes.description: Styles for visual representation of player tokens, including size and background color.

classes.name: dice
classes.description: Styles for the dice display, including size, color, and hover effects.

classes.name: square
classes.description: Styles for squares in the game board, including appearance on hover and transition effects.

classes.name: reset-button
classes.description: Styles for the reset button in the game controls, including color and hover effects.
